description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the JobCategoryService in the OrangeHRM project, testing methods related to retrieving job categories.

classes.name: JobCategoryServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying functionality of JobCategoryService methods, including fetching job categories and by ID.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating a JobCategoryService instance and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the list of job categories from the service, mocking the DAO layer.

methods.name: testGtJobCategoryById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single job category by ID, mocking the DAO layer.
